Module com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship
Package com.example.miniproyecto3_battleship.model.ships

Interface IShip

All Known Implementing Classes:
Destructor, Fragata, Portaaviones, Ship, Submarino
public interface IShip
Represents the contract for all ship types in the Battleship game.

This interface defines the methods required for managing the visual representation, orientation, placement, and status of ships in the game.

Author:
Nicolas Cordoba, Samuel Arenas, Juan Manuel Ampudia

  • Method Details

    • selectDesing

      void selectDesing()
      Applies a glowing effect to the ship to indicate it is selected.

      This method adds a white glow effect to the ship to visually represent that it has been selected. It also sets the isSelect flag to true.

    • originDesing

      void originDesing()
      Restores the ship's original design and removes the selection effect.

      This method removes the glow effect applied during selection and resets the ship's visual appearance to its original state. It also sets the isSelect flag to false.

    • rotateShip

      void rotateShip()
      Rotates the ship's orientation by 90 degrees.

      If the ship is currently horizontal, this method will rotate it to a vertical orientation, and vice versa. It updates the isHorizontal flag accordingly.

    • setIsHorizontal

      void setIsHorizontal(boolean isHorizontal)
      Sets the ship's orientation.

      This method sets the isHorizontal flag to the specified value, which determines whether the ship is placed horizontally or vertically.

      Parameters:
      isHorizontal - a boolean value indicating whether the ship should be oriented horizontally (true) or vertically (false).

    • setPosition

      void setPosition(int x, int y)
      Sets the position of the ship on the game board.

      This method updates the position array with the specified coordinates for the ship's placement on the board.

      Parameters:
      x - the row coordinate of the ship's position.
      y - the column coordinate of the ship's position.

    • getPosition

      int[] getPosition()
      Retrieves the current position of the ship.

      This method returns the position array containing the ship's current coordinates (row and column).

      Returns:
      an array of two integers, where the first element is the row and the second element is the column of the ship's position.

    • isSelect

      boolean isSelect()
      Checks whether the ship is currently selected.

      This method returns the value of the isSelect flag, which indicates if the ship is currently selected for placement or manipulation.

      Returns:
      true if the ship is selected, false otherwise.

    • getSize

      int getSize()
      Retrieves the size of the ship.

      This method returns the size of the ship, which corresponds to the number of cells the ship occupies on the game board.

      Returns:
      the size of the ship as an integer.

    • isPlaced

      boolean isPlaced()
      Checks whether the ship has been placed on the game board.

      This method returns the value of the isPlaced flag, which indicates whether the ship has been placed on the board.

      Returns:
      true if the ship has been placed, false otherwise.

    • setIsPlaced

      void setIsPlaced(boolean isPlaced)
      Sets the placement status of the ship.

      This method updates the isPlaced flag to the specified value, indicating whether the ship has been placed on the board or not.

      Parameters:
      isPlaced - a boolean value indicating whether the ship has been placed on the board (true) or not (false).

    • isHorizontal

      boolean isHorizontal()
      Checks whether the ship is placed horizontally.

      This method returns the value of the isHorizontal flag, which indicates whether the ship is currently placed horizontally or vertically.

      Returns:
      true if the ship is horizontal, false if it is vertical.

    • setPotentialRotate

      void setPotentialRotate(boolean potentialRotate)
      Sets whether the ship has the potential to be rotated.

      This method updates the potentialRotate flag, which determines whether the ship can be rotated based on its current position and orientation.

      Parameters:
      potentialRotate - a boolean value indicating whether the ship can be rotated.

    • potentialRotate

      boolean potentialRotate()
      Checks if the ship has the potential to be rotated.

      This method returns the value of the potentialRotate flag, which indicates whether the ship can be rotated based on its current position.

      Returns:
      true if the ship can be rotated, false otherwise.

    • setIsSelect

      void setIsSelect(boolean isSelect)
      Sets the selection status of the ship.

      This method updates the isSelect flag to the specified value, indicating whether the ship is selected or not.

      Parameters:
      isSelect - a boolean value indicating whether the ship is selected.

    • setScaleShip

      void setScaleShip(double X, double Y)
      Sets the scale of the ship for rendering.

      This method scales the ship's visual representation by the specified factors for the X and Y axes.

      Parameters:
      X - the scaling factor for the X-axis (width).
      Y - the scaling factor for the Y-axis (height).

    • setIsDestroyed

      void setIsDestroyed(boolean isDestroyed)
      Sets the destruction status of the ship.

      This method updates the isDestroyed flag, which indicates whether the ship has been destroyed or not.

      Parameters:
      isDestroyed - a boolean value indicating whether the ship is destroyed.

    • isDestroyed

      boolean isDestroyed()
      Checks whether the ship has been destroyed.

      This method returns the value of the isDestroyed flag, which indicates whether the ship has been destroyed after being hit.

      Returns:
